subject: Intro + compact runbook: EverGrid demo & IT vetting
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New inbound trial -> EverGrid (requested demo) — quick intake

Hi team,

Heads-up: EverGrid (Samir Patel) converted from the self-serve sandbox and requested a 30m demo to review API integration and data isolation options. Their form notes an "IT security attendance required" and they listed Marta Ruiz (IT) as the contact.

Snapshot:
- Company: EverGrid (energy analytics)
- Size: ~120 engineers; sensitive PII noted in logs they sent during signup
- Wants: demo of hosted vs. private deployment and details on audit logs/SOC2 evidence
- Lead: Samir Patel (samir.patel@evergrid.com)

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Rafael / Lauren to lead demo (30m).
2) Monica join for a 10–15 min technical deep-dive on networking and audit logs.
3) Ask IT (Marta) for any required checklist items up front.

I've added a very light calendar poll link below (their timezone looked like US/PST). Can someone confirm availability for next week (Oct 5–9) or I can schedule a compact slot Oct 10–12 if the AE prefers.

Calendly: https://cal.example.com/raf-evergrid-30m
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/EG-2026-0427

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
SDR, Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@evergrid.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@evergrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + compact runbook: EverGrid demo & IT vetting

Hi Samir / Marta — Rafael from Redwood here, great to meet you. Thanks for signing up and flagging IT attendance.

Quick note on format: we typically run a 30-minute compact demo where we: 1) surface fit and roadmap relevance (5–7m), 2) show a short hosted API walkthrough (10–12m), and 3) hand off to the SE for networking/audit-logs (8–10m). We'll leave 3–5 minutes for next steps.

Marta — can you share any hard blockers for attendance (e.g., must be on-prem-only demos, need firewall IP ranges, or an approved NDA)? If you prefer, Monica can send a short checklist (we'll attach a readiness checklist).

Proposed times (all PDT):
- Mon Oct 5 — 10:00–10:30
- Tue Oct 6 — 08:30–09:00 or 16:00–16:30
- Fri Oct 9 — 11:00–11:30

If none of these work, we can schedule Oct 12–13 and I can coordinate a 60m slot to accommodate more stakeholders.

I've attached a pilot readiness checklist for IT to scan before the call. Also linking a short security brief.

Attachments: evergrid-pilot-readiness-checklist.pdf (pdf)
Links: https://docsend.example.com/evergrid-security-brief

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@evergrid.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@evergrid.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + compact runbook: EverGrid demo & IT vetting

Thanks Rafael — Tues Oct 6 at 08:30 PDT works best for our team (we'll put a tentative hold). Marta will join for the end of the call (she's on a rotating on-call schedule and may need the 16:00 option if her window shifts).

We have two quick asks before the demo:
1) Can you share the list of outbound IP ranges and the ingest path? We need that for our firewall team.
2) Do you have a short SOC2 artifact (audit scope) or an evidence summary we can review pre-demo?

If you prefer, we can do 16:00 PDT instead; will confirm by EOD Monday.

— Samir
VP, Product — EverGrid

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@evergrid.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@evergrid.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T07:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + compact runbook: EverGrid demo & IT vetting

Hi Marta / Samir — Monica (SE) here. Quick answers inline and a short ask about demo scope.

- Outbound IPs: we publish a small set of ranges for hosted egress. I'll paste the CIDR blocks below and attach a one-page networking guide.
- SOC2: we can share a redacted evidence summary and a SOC2 letter; I'll post a DocSend link before the call.

Networking (hosted) - common egress ranges: 34.201.0.0/16, 52.24.0.0/14 (please confirm with your firewall team).

Demo scope ask: to respect Marta's time, if you can send 2–3 prioritized network/audit questions we can address those first in the technical segment.

Attachment: compact-demo-agenda.ics (calendar invite stub)

Thanks — Monica
Staff Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@evergrid.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@evergrid.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T00:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + compact runbook: EverGrid demo & IT vetting

Hi all — thanks for the details. Tue Oct 6 08:30 PDT should work for me; if anything changes I'll move to the 16:00 slot and confirm.

Prioritized questions:
1) Which audit events are logged and retained (authentication, admin changes, data access) and can we configure retention?
2) How does Redwood handle KV cache and memory isolation for shared GPUs in hosted mode?
3) What encryption-in-transit and at-rest mechanisms are used, and where are keys managed?

If you can forward a one-page answer set to those three items before the call, I'll be able to join for the last 12 minutes and close any blockers.

Marta
IT Security Lead — EverGrid

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@evergrid.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@evergrid.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final prep + compact demo invite (Tue Oct 6 08:30 PDT confirmed)

Thanks everyone — calendar hold confirmed for Tue Oct 6, 08:30–09:00 PDT (invite attached). Quick deliverables before the call:
- Monica / Grace: sending the 1-pager (answers to Marta's three questions) — Monica, can you post the DocSend link?
- Vivek: please include the HubSpot deal link and note the free trial quota we set (so AE can mention activation steps).
- Samir: please share any additional stakeholders who should join (ops or compliance).

Attached: compact-demo-agenda.ics (calendar invite), evergrid-pilot-readiness-checklist.pdf
Links: https://docsend.example.com/evergrid-security-brief, https://hubspot.example.com/deal/EG-2026-0427

If Marta can join for the final 12 minutes, we'll cover audit logs and retention and confirm next steps for a short pilot. If she cannot make it live, we'll record the segment and send the evidence package.

See you Tuesday,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
